Debian DSA-6264-1 fixed related DNSSEC validation DoS CVE-2026-4890 in trixie 2.91-1+deb13u1, which this package ships. CVE-2026-13002 (infinite loop in dnssec.c NSEC/NSEC3 bitmap parsing, Debian bug #1144649) remains unfixed on the tracker for 2.91-1+deb13u1 and sid 2.93-1; Red Hat #2486360 has no Fixed In Version. When DNSSEC validation is enabled, an attacker controlling a DNSSEC-signed zone can hang dnsmasq. Debian shipped defaults do not enable DNSSEC validation.
